The omnitron and omnitron X story lines are kinda hard to put together, but heres what I think:

Omnitron 1 - became sentient, rampaged a bit, and was defeated by the F5.

Omnitron 2 - given new life from a mysterious cosmic force, came back, rampaged a bit, and is defeated during the comic story line "Singularity" where Omni-X makes his huge sacrifice to blow omnitron into a million pieces. Those bits find there way into various places and hands…like Baron Blade.

Omnitron 3 - Baron assembled some fragments and used Omnitron to battle with him during Vengeance

Omnitron 4 - Some of those fragments and pieces of code blown up by Omni-X make their way to Mars, where Omnitron tries a different approach and turns himself into a massive factory. Various villains go there to use Omnitron for their means, and at some point Omni-X (who's still in existence because comics and time-space shenanigans) finds himself there again to stop his past self, but somehow this new form overtakes Omni-X and assimilates him to probably build an early proto-type of the Omni-Reaper that we saw in the Tactics Kickstarter.
